purpose: Teach: 風速/乗船/高熱/鼓動/洗顔/授乳/浄水/脊髄

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、災害時の風速予測を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren, we use wind speed forecasting during disasters as a reference point for our medical team's planning.
lines.style: Clear, informational opening. Steady pace, professional but not stiff. Light emphasis on 'we' — inclusive. Slight pause before the procedural detail, showing thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者搬送時の乗船指示を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes — we manage patient transport and boarding procedures as a coordinated function of our medical team.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Slower tempo on the procedural terms. Calm, reassuring undertone. Speaks as though explaining something important she's thought through carefully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の高熱対応を医療チームで研修します
lines.en: Ren, we conduct training on high-fever response protocols for pediatric patients across our entire medical team.
lines.style: Deliberate, methodical. Slight weight on 'conduct' — this is established practice. Even pace. Professional warmth underneath — she takes this seriously because patients depend on it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 胎児の心臓鼓動を、貴院、エコーで確認されますね、先生
lines.en: So you do use echocardiography to confirm fetal cardiac function here at your hospital, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet intellectually curious. Careful phrasing — testing knowledge without presumption. Slight lift at the end seeking confirmation. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、術後の洗顔指導を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes — we provide postoperative wound care instruction as a standard protocol managed by our medical team.
lines.style: Calm, procedural affirmation. Even pacing. The rhythm of someone stating established fact. Not defensive, just clear. Professional courtesy in her tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 授乳外来を、貴院、設けられてますね、先生
lines.en: You do have a dedicated lactation consultation clinic here at your hospital, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful inquiry, genuinely interested. Soft cadence on the question. Observant — asking about something he's noticed or inferred. Seeking gentle confirmation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、浄水フィルターを医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes — our medical team maintains strict protocols for water purification and filtration management.
lines.style: Assured, straightforward. Measured tempo. Light emphasis on 'strict' — this is non-negotiable. Professional, almost clinical in its confidence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、脊髄損傷患者のリハビリを医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes — we coordinate spinal cord injury rehabilitation across our medical team and follow through comprehensively.
lines.style: Grounded and steady. Warm undertone on 'follow through' — suggesting long-term commitment to patients. Slight deliberate close, as though this is a point she wants to land clearly.
